about: The source model of an MP3 file (spec/virtualize/mp3.md §5.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/mp3.md#53-elements>): the elements a parser emits, and the roles the file, each ID3v2 tag, the stream's first frame, a frame of another stream and the audio play, each with the constraints a file must meet to have the MP3 convention's layout (spec/virtualize/mp3.md §8.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/mp3.md#81-the-stream>). The parser checks them in this order; projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

layers.about: the layer bits of a frame header: its name

elements.about: The IR of an MP3 file. n is a tag's size, L a frame's length, S the samples per channel of a frame (1152 for MPEG-1, 576 for MPEG-2 and 2.5), C the channel count.

id3v2/<k>.about: the k-th ID3v2 tag at the front of the file, k from 0; its extent the whole tag

id3v2/<k>/data.extent: (at + 10, n), when n > 0: the tag's frames and padding, opaque

id3v2/<k>/footer.extent: (at + 10 + n, 10), when the header's footer flag (0x10) is set

info.extent: the stream's first frame, when it holds a Xing, Info or VBRI tag: not an audio frame

frames.about: the audio frames; its extent from the first frame's start to the last frame's end

frames/<j>.form: {geometry: {samples: S, channels: C, data_type: int16}, codec: {name: mp3, version, sample_rate}, recipe: [[src, 0, null]]}
frames/<j>.extent: (offset, L): audio frame j, j from 0, header included

id3v1.extent: (size - 128, 128), when the file ends with TAG there

ape.extent: the APE tag before the ID3v1 tag (or at the end), footer and header included, opaque

gaps/<offset>.about: bytes no frame or tag holds: junk between frames, a truncated last frame, bytes after the last frame

constraints.message: file too short for an MPEG audio frame header

given.total: 10 + the size field + 10 for a footer
given.syncsafe: whether every size byte is below 0x80
given.byte: the first size byte that is not, when one is

constraints.message: the ID3v2 tag at {at} has no 10-byte header: the file ends at {size}
the ID3v2 tag at {at} has a size byte that is not syncsafe ({byte})
the {total}-byte ID3v2 tag at {at} is outside the {size}-byte file
{version} Layer {layer_name} (the frame at {at}) is not supported: only Layer III is

given.what: the first parameter it changes: version, layer, sample rate or channel count

constraints.message: the frame at {at} changes the {what} from {from} to {to}

given.free: the offset of the first free-format header met, when one was

constraints.message: free-format bitrate (the frame header at {free}) is not supported
